verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents CSV export of filtered transactions through its MCP server, transaction exports that carry reference IDs, timestamps and on-chain hashes, sync to NetSuite/QuickBooks/Xero, and developer APIs for cards, payments, transactions and expense data. Together these let a user extract core financial records in open or portable forms. Coverage is limited to transaction and spend data, not a documented full-account export or exit path. Missing for 10: a documented complete export of all account data (receipts, memos, users, vendors, settings), any account-closure or offboarding process, and independent or hands-on corroboration of export completeness.
